name: Christmas at Marisol Bay
source:
Kyro usually spends Christmas Eve with his parents and younger sister, Nova. But this year the plans are different. Kyro and Nova find themselves spending Christmas Eve at Liam's house with Wyatt, Mrs.V, and her grandson, Stellan.

[From [url=https://legendex-games.itch.io/christmas-at-marisol-bay]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
凯罗通常会与父母、妹妹诺娃一起过平安夜。不过，今年的安排有些不同。凯罗与诺娃将来到利亚姆家，与怀亚特、V夫人及她的孙子斯特兰，一同度过平安夜。

[摘自[url=https://legendex-games.itch.io/christmas-at-marisol-bay]itch.io[/url]]
